# Data Source: stripe_financial_connections_account_owner

An owner of a bank account linked through Financial Connections, as the account's institution reported it. Look one up by the `account` and the owner's `id`. An account has owners only after an ownership refresh, which needs its `ownership` permission, and this data source never starts one: refresh the account's ownership through Stripe's API first (`POST /v1/financial_connections/accounts/{account}/refresh` with `features[]=ownership`) and read the owner once the account's `ownership_refresh.status` is `succeeded`. Each refresh makes a new ownership whose owners have new IDs, and `ownership` defaults to the account's latest, so set it to keep reading an owner after a later refresh.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_financial_connections_account_owner" "holder" {
  account = "fca_1MwVK82eZvKYlo2Cjw8FMxXf"
  id      = "fcaown_1MwVK92eZvKYlo2CaY4DmLpV"
}

output "owner_name" {
  value = data.stripe_financial_connections_account_owner.holder.name
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `account` - (Required) The ID of the parent object.
* `id` - (Required) The ID of the financial connections account owner to read.
* `ownership` - (Optional) The ID of the ownership the owner belongs to. Defaults to the account's latest `ownership`.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `email` - The email address of the owner.
* `name` - The full name of the owner.
* `phone` - The raw phone number of the owner.
* `raw_address` - The raw physical address of the owner.
* `refreshed_at` - The timestamp of the refresh that updated this owner.
